title: Phase15CinematicStoryboardSchema
description: Authoritative schema for Phase 15 Cinematic Vox Visual Journalism Storyboards combining Vox storytelling grammar with Company Paper Diorama art direction.

narration.description: Exact voiceover narration sentence for this beat

visual_argument.description: Editorial visual demonstration proving the narration claim (non-negotiable Vox core rule)

visual_metaphor.description: Concrete visual analogy representing an abstract market concept

style_mode.description: Dynamic company art direction mode serving the narration need

background.description: Deepest Z-layer: archival maps, newsprint grids, textured parchment

midground.description: Core subject layer: B&W halftone cutouts, white keylines, offset red marker strokes

foreground.description: Front Z-layer: giant stat numbers, editorial tags, flying fragments crossing lens

company_style_components.description: Preserved company art direction materials (halftone cutouts, archival paper, red strokes, etc.)

vox_visual_components.description: Active Vox concepts in this scene (VOX_HOOK, VOX_INFORMATION_BUILD, etc.)

camera_move.description: One committed cinematic camera movement per clip through 2.5D space

depth.description: 2.5D Z-depth staging and parallax cues (foreground, midground, background planes)

transformation.description: Visual transformation linking one visual element into the next for continuous flow

transition_out.description: Outbound transition or match-cut into subsequent beat

sound_events.description: Diegetic and editorial sound punctuation (paper pops, thwips, stamps, ticks, risers)

approved_numbers.description: Factually verified numbers (only 1,482,930, 68.4%, 14.6 hours, or narrative 2:17 AM)
